claim: The assumed implicit momentum equation has the implemented tissue/gravity/damping torque signs.
implementation: web/anatomical-coupled-fixture.mjs: stepCoupledFixture torqueBalanceNm and coupledObjective qGradient.

claim: Twice the joint kinetic increment plus twice its implicit kinetic defect equals twice the end-velocity inertial work.
implementation: web/anatomical-coupled-fixture.mjs: jointImplicitDissipationJ and joint kinetic ledger.
assumptions: Exact integer inertia and old/new angular velocities; positive common physical scales interpret numerator factors of two.
limitations: Only angular kinetic algebra; no tissue potential, metabolic work or whole-system conservation claim.
numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical-coupling.test.mjs, anatomical-tangent.test.mjs, anatomical-element.test.mjs and anatomical-material.test.mjs; applicable independent derivative, transfer, state and torque checks.

claim: The assumed implicit momentum equation gives the joint angular work balance including damping and implicit kinetic defect.
assumptions: Exact integer quantities in compatible scales; the implemented angular stationarity relation is supplied.
limitations: Does not prove full tissue/joint energy conservation. Nonlinear endpoint-work defects are measured separately.

claim: The angular implicit kinetic and damping defect numerator is nonnegative under nonnegative inertia, step and damping.
assumptions: Integer inertia, h and damping are nonnegative; velocities arbitrary; positive common scales and factors of two.
limitations: No total-energy monotonicity under activation, nonlinear potentials, external mass changes or solver errors follows.
numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical-coupling.test.mjs, anatomical-tangent.test.mjs, anatomical-element.test.mjs and anatomical-material.test.mjs; applicable independent derivative, transfer, state and torque checks.

claim: At fixed pose and velocity, changing point-mass inertia and downward-positive gravitational potential gives the recorded external mass-event work numerator.
assumptions: Exact integer fixed pose/velocity, delta mass and squared grip radius; I changes by deltaMass*radiusSquared; fixture z is downward-positive.
limitations: State preservation, real geometry, signs for other world conventions and browser arithmetic need independent checks.
numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical-coupling.test.mjs, anatomical-tangent.test.mjs, anatomical-element.test.mjs and anatomical-material.test.mjs; applicable independent derivative, transfer, state and torque checks.

claim: Four corner and six midside shape-weight numerators sum to the squared common barycentric denominator.
assumptions: Exact integer barycentric numerators sum to d; rational interpretation requires d>0. Corner numerators are 2*l_i^2-d*l_i and edge numerators 4*l_i*l_j.
limitations: No claim about irrational quadrature values, geometry, gradients, floating-point evaluation or anatomical fidelity is established.
numerical_evidence: tests/anatomical-coupling.test.mjs, anatomical-tangent.test.mjs, anatomical-element.test.mjs and anatomical-material.test.mjs; applicable independent derivative, transfer, state and torque checks.
